items.prompt: Citra has Rp240.000. She spends 3/8 of it on books. She then spends 1/4 of what is left on snacks. How many rupiah does she have now?
hints: Then find 1/4 of what is left and take that away.

items.prompt: How many bottles of 2/3 litre can be filled from 6 litres of juice?
hints: There are 3 thirds in every litre.
6 litres is 18 thirds. How many groups of 2 thirds?

options.why: You found 2/3 of 6. We need the number of 2/3s inside 6.
Each bottle holds less than 1 litre, so more than 6 bottles can be filled.
You may have divided 6 by 2 and ignored the 3 in the denominator.

items.prompt: Sekar eats 3/4 of the 2/5 of a cake that was left in the fridge. What fraction of the whole cake did she eat?
hints: Multiply the numerators and then the denominators.
